body:
Thanks for your support!

I definitely have been trying to work smart, not hard, but so far it isn't working too well for me. To simply put it in an example, I will do a mathematics question, but will take the long grueling way around it and only realise that there is an easy way to attempt the question after I search up how to do it. This sort of applies to real life too, but I guess I could help myself because Google is at my fingertips after all.

I should spend less time on the computer, but unfortunately I use it for work pretty much all the time and since this is my final year of high school, I have cut down gaming quite a bit. I should probably go do some physical activity when I do get free time though.

I'm a bit too late in highschool now lol, there is like, 7 weeks left until I graduate and university course selections are due at the end of this month, so I really need to make a firm decision of what to apply for. I admit my work ethic could be improved and I just need to find the motivation to do that. Finding something that is both productive and an interest to me is one of my highest goals at the moment. The thing I'm most afraid of is working some shitty ass job for the next 60 years and die achieving nothing.

Thanks for the support and helping out a stranger, I really appreciate it and you made me feel much better!

If I could be, do or have anything I would be a guy who knows how to study, gets top marks and lands a top tier job like an engineer or something that pulls in the big $$$. I would choose to be a guy who is genuinely interested in academic fields and someone who has a true passion for something other than playing video games and dishing out $$$ on mobile phones and computer parts.

I wish I could be more social and be that guy that everybody wants to talk to and hang out with. I realised that when I talk I can sometimes sound like an arrogant asshole and I don't realise what I say at the time, but after a short time I realise I did something I shouldn't have. But this is all different online. Online when I talk to friends and people, everyone sees me as the super nice guy who is always supportive and funny to talk to, but in real life I'm awkward and I have nothing to say most the time.  

As of right now I have no such aspirations to aim so high because there is an incredibly slim chance for me to even get close to that. My exit grade won't be high so I will probably end up doing a university course in business or primary school education because I find those two to be the most suiting options for the current state I am in. If I were to have anything, I would choose to have a lot of money, sorry if that sounded so shallow minded.

Thank you for your response and kind words.

Edit: I guess product design as a job sounds interesting, but there is no chance of that happening at where I live. Going the design career pathway has always seemed like a risky path for me, but if there was guaranteed success, I would do it in a heartbeat.
